title: Untrack the build output that was committed by accident
goal: Three thousand three hundred and ninety files under debug/ (92 MB tracked, 886 MB on disk) plus .rustc_info.json were committed by an unrelated workflow fix on 2026-09-30 - a git add -A that swept up a stray cargo target directory. debug/ is not in .gitignore, so every build mutates tracked files and every worktree goes dirty; it is also 92 MB in every clone. Untrack both, ignore them at the root, and add a check that fails when build output is tracked at all, so the accident cannot recur.
